mission: HEADROOM PHASE-3 - CONMED POPULATION CONTINUATION (remaining candidates only; same pipeline, same budget, one attempt each)
whyPartial: Every one of the 133 attemptable candidates now has exactly one disposition, but ten of them (7.9(a)(i) through 7.9(d)) were never served: from 08:06:27Z the Vercel AI Gateway refused every request with HTTP 402 insufficient_funds (credit balance exhausted) before any model work, and 7.9(a) was refused mid-compile after 29,406 billed input tokens. Not retried (one attempt, no mid-run remediation, no credits to add from inside the mission). Two further candidates remain IN_FLIGHT_UNKNOWN (7.6(f)(i) from the original run, 7.6(g) from continuation segment 1), each killed by a container reclaim with no local trace of the request and therefore never rerun. The evidence itself validates completely: zero secret hits, every package hash re-checked, every ledger reconciled with no double counting, no prior candidate re-attempted.
